name: Philips Hue Sync
overview: Adds support-bundle FFmpeg flag redaction, POST-only entertainment-area loading, in-process scheduled-cue overlap recovery and attribute-safe administrator mapping controls. Adds complete non-success scheduled brightness telemetry and a stable integer duration request shape with omission tracking and explicit zero clearing. Adds direct scheduled-scene brightness overrides bounded to 0-100 with null-as-inherit semantics, playlist safety, credential-free runtime/status/history/occurrence/export parity, safe partial-update preservation, administrator controls, and regression coverage. Adds credential-free playlist rename migration and nullable scheduled-scene RGB channel overrides with inherited saved-scene colors, complete scheduler/runtime/history/occurrence export parity, administrator controls, validation, and self-hosted workflow timeout hardening. Adds nullable per-step playlist RGB channel overrides with 0-255 validation, null-as-inherit behavior, and full runtime, scheduler, telemetry, API/UI, export, duplication, and backup parity. Effective colors flow through continuous and non-continuous previews, occurrence plans, history, and credential-free backup/restore. Adds nullable per-step playlist effect overrides with null-as-inherit semantics and full runtime, scheduler, telemetry, API/UI, export, duplication, and backup parity. Runs each expanded playlist in one preflighted capture, activation, continuous DTLS stream, deactivation, and restoration lifecycle per target, with duplicate-label-safe and cancellation-safe telemetry. Locks NuGet dependency graphs and uses separate least-privileged self-hosted build and release identities, trusted-only triggers, a daily version monitor, and fail-closed release tags. Adds nullable per-step playlist effect-speed overrides with null-as-inherit semantics, 25-400% validation, non-solid runtime propagation, expanded occurrence/history telemetry, API/UI/CSV/iCalendar/backup parity, and regression coverage. Adds nullable per-step playlist fade-curve overrides with null-as-inherit semantics, easing-capable runtime propagation, effective scheduled/history/occurrence telemetry, API/UI/CSV/iCalendar/backup parity, and regression coverage. Adds nullable per-step playlist fade-in and fade-out overrides with null-as-inherit semantics, safe duration clamping, effective transition and cumulative offset telemetry, and complete preview/scheduler/history/API/UI/JSON/CSV/iCalendar/backup parity. Adds regression coverage for validation, inheritance, round trips, runtime payloads, persisted history, and configuration-page contracts. Adds expanded credential-free upcoming playlist step plans with stable occurrence-date shuffle/repeat ordering, effective brightness/duration/transition metadata, cumulative offsets, JSON/CSV/iCalendar export parity, and administrator visibility. Adds per-step playlist brightness overrides with null-as-inherit semantics and persists complete credential-free playlist step telemetry through scheduler history and restart. Adds saved-playlist per-step hold duration overrides with bounded 1-30 second values, zero-as-inherit legacy behavior, effective timing telemetry, scheduler/preview parity, API/UI controls, duplication, and credential-safe backup/restore. Adds configurable Linear, SmoothStep, EaseIn, EaseOut, and EaseInOut fade curves to direct and saved scene previews, with normalized backward-compatible persistence, scheduler/playlist parity, API/UI telemetry, CSV/iCalendar metadata, and credential-safe backup compatibility. Adds saved-playlist Sequential or stable date-seeded Shuffle playback order with original saved-position telemetry across previews, scheduled cues, runtime/history/status/occurrence metadata, duplication, API/UI, backup/restore, and administrator controls. Adds deterministic Starlight scene effects with cool white-blue twinkles, sharp glints, and independent channel phases across previews, saved scenes, playlists, scheduled cues, and portability. Adds SolarNoon scheduled cues using NOAA equation-of-time math with portable offsets, coordinates, time zones, scheduler recovery, API/UI, exports, and backup/restore. Adds nautical and astronomical dawn/dusk scheduled cues using NOAA 12-degree and 18-degree-below-horizon solar events, completing the standard twilight bands with portable offsets, coordinates, time zones, scheduler recovery, API/UI, exports, and backup/restore. Adds civil dawn and civil dusk scheduled cues using 6-degree-below-horizon solar events with portable offsets, coordinates, time zones, and full scheduler/API/UI/backup coverage. Adds deterministic Lightning scene effects with electric blue/white storm flashes and independent channel phases across previews, saved scenes, playlists, scheduled cues, and portability. Adds cross-midnight-safe solar scheduling: bounded offsets may shift sunrise/sunset into the adjacent local date while recurrence and date windows remain anchored to the base solar event, with due checks, previews, run-slot de-duplication, and catch-up recovery aligned. Adds solar-aware Fixed, Sunrise, and Sunset scheduled cues with bounded offsets and portable decimal coordinates, DST-safe cue-time-zone resolution, polar no-event handling, API/status/occurrence/CSV/iCalendar/backup/restore portability, and administrator controls. Adds deterministic Fire and Ocean scene effects with high-energy red/amber/yellow flicker and rolling blue/cyan waves, portable preview/saved-scene/playlist/scheduler support, administrator controls, and credential-free telemetry. Adds global and per-user spatial orientation calibration with Normal, MirrorHorizontal, MirrorVertical, Rotate180, Rotate90Clockwise, and Rotate90Counterclockwise modes, consistent video sampling and audio spatial/stereo routing, runtime telemetry, backup/import portability, and administrator controls. Adds global and per-user color temperature correction from 1000 K to 20000 K with a neutral 6500 K daylight default, consistent video/audio application after channel gains, runtime telemetry, backup/import portability, and administrator controls. Adds global and per-user contrast correction from 50% to 200% around mid-gray with a neutral 100% default, consistent video/audio application after gamma, runtime telemetry, backup/import portability, and administrator controls. Adds global and per-user gamma color correction from 0.5 to 2.5 with neutral 1.0 defaults, consistent video/audio application, runtime telemetry, backup/import portability, and administrator controls. Adds configurable dark-scene Blackout or KeepLastColors behavior with global and per-user policies, runtime telemetry, backup/import portability, and administrator controls. Adds pause-time DimToCinemaLevel behavior so paused playback dims captured lights to the effective cinema level without resetting streamed colors. Adds per-user pause-policy overrides, brightness-only bridge updates with retries, safe snapshot lifecycle cleanup, and credential-safe pause telemetry. Adds target-aware scheduled playback conflict scope with AnyTarget or MatchingTarget behavior, allowing independent Hue rooms to run while another room is playing. Adds scoped lifecycle arbitration and credential-safe conflict-scope telemetry. Adds per-cue playback conflict overrides with global inheritance or per-cue Skip and bounded Defer behavior. Adds restart-safe playback-aware scheduled cues with a configurable Skip or bounded Defer policy that yields to active playback, persists one pending occurrence across Jellyfin restarts, retries after playback ends, and records restored or expired waits safely. Adds playback-aware scheduled cues with a configurable Skip or bounded Defer policy that yields to active playback, retries after playback ends, and records expired waits safely. Adds support for real-time lighting synchronization with Philips Hue Entertainment Areas using the streaming DTLS API. Audio playback supports configurable sensitivity, noise-gate suppression, low/mid/high band centers and gains, response smoothing, band spread, beat pulses with bounded release and onset threshold, palettes, spatial routing, and source-channel selection.
